policy: No raw question or context text is stored in this repository. Only dataset identifiers, versions, licenses, checksums, and derived statistics are tracked. Upstream SQuAD and HotpotQA licenses (CC BY-SA 4.0) remain in force.

datasets.name: Stanford Question Answering Dataset
datasets.citation: Rajpurkar et al., SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text, EMNLP 2016.

corpus.construction: unique contexts truncated to 256 words, chunked into 70-word passages, no overlap

datasets.notes: P0 golden, P1 primary, replication, boundary/context, and tax IDs are tracked in data/splits/squad_splits.json. P0 is disjoint from P1.

datasets.name: HotpotQA
datasets.citation: Yang et al., HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering, EMNLP 2018.

corpus.construction: 10 provided paragraphs per question (2 gold, 8 distractors); no cross-question pooling

datasets.notes: Multi-hop/distractor stress condition. BM25 over 10 paragraphs is a weak retriever; report supporting-fact recall separately. The distractor set is constructed, not natural.
